privacy.lead: The statement below covers the Rotaris application and Rotaris Cloud. For this website itself the following applies — it is static and processes nothing beyond serving the page:

facts.storage: No cookies, no local storage, no session storage.
facts.analytics: No analytics and no tracking services.
facts.thirdParty: No third-party resources at runtime — fonts and icons are served from this same domain, and no request goes to a CDN or to Google Fonts.
facts.forms: No account, no form, no submission of anything you type.
facts.detection: Operating-system detection for the download recommendation evaluates the browser's user agent locally and only there.
facts.logs: What remains are the web server's access logs (IP address, timestamp, requested path, status code) on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Controller and data-subject rights as under sections 1 and 9.

privacy.note: This list describes the current state of this website and has to be checked whenever it changes. It is the place for the separate website privacy statement that the document below refers to in its opening paragraph, and it is no substitute for that document's legal review.
privacy.authoritative: This English list is a convenience translation. The German version on the German page is the authoritative wording.

imprint.vatOpen: Enter the VAT identification number under § 27a UStG as soon as it has been issued. Until then this entry stays empty; the tax number does not belong in the imprint.
imprint.dataProtection: We have not appointed a data protection officer; the statutory conditions of Art. 37 GDPR and § 38 BDSG are not met in our case. Send data protection enquiries to <0>{{email}}</0>. The details are set out in the <1>privacy policy</1>.
imprint.disputes: We are neither willing nor obliged to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board (§ 36 VSBG).
imprint.security: Reports of security vulnerabilities go to <0>{{email}}</0>. The procedure is set out in the <1>SECURITY.md</1> in the source repository.
imprint.liability: As a service provider we are responsible for our own content on these pages under the general laws. The operators of external links are solely responsible for their content. No infringements were apparent at the time of linking; we remove such links immediately once we learn of them.
